articles.headline: Volpe rejoins Yankees after Chisholm hits IL with sprained thumb
articles.description: Anthony Volpe rejoined the Yankees on Thursday after the team placed second baseman Jazz Chisholm Jr. on the 10-day injured list with a thumb sprain.
